projects.title: Licensed electrical engineer: low-voltage cabling for LED lighting systems -- 2
projects.description:
We design, manufacture and distribute permanent architectural LED lighting systems that are installed on residential and commercial buildings throughout the United States. 
To support our continued growth, we are engaging an experienced electrical engineer to independently evaluate and recommend the most suitable wiring solutions for our installations. 
Our systems operate at 24V and 36V DC and use a three-conductor configuration comprising positive, negative and digital data lines, supplemented by dedicated power-injection runs. 
These cables are routed through garages, interior walls, attics and soffits before terminating in exterior aluminum lighting tracks. 
The tracks are mounted both beneath protected roof eaves and along fully exposed rooflines, where they are subject to rain, condensation, prolonged UV exposure and extreme temperature swings. 
Your primary task will be to identify flexible, stranded-copper cables, ideally 16/3 or 16/4 for combined power and data and 14/2 for power injection. 
We welcome well-reasoned alternative constructions if they offer superior performance, durability or value. 
We expect you to research manufacturers and specific products independently rather than relying on a single distributor's catalog. For every recommended cable, you will verify the UL or ETL listing, the applicable cable-type marking and full compliance with NEC Article 725 and its corresponding provisions in the 2023 NEC. 
You will also confirm each product's suitability for in-wall, attic and wet-location use, along with its moisture resistance and sunlight resistance. In addition, the assessment should document rated operating temperatures, minimum installation temperatures for cold-weather work and overall cable flexibility. 
Of particular importance is a clear determination of whether our 36V DC circuits in wet, exposed locations remain within Class 2 limits, together with the implications if they do not. 
Our objective is to standardize on cost-effective products that are readily available in the US, with at least one qualified alternate for each cable category.
The final deliverable will be a professional written report presenting the recommended cables with their part numbers, verified certifications, approved applications, suppliers and current pricing. The report should include a side-by-side comparison table as well as links to manufacturer datasheets and certification records. 
Candidates holding an electrical PE license and proven expertise in NEC Article 725, low-voltage lighting and UL/ETL certification will be given strong preference.

projects.title: UE5 Frame-Accurate Brawler Combat System
projects.description:
I'm looking for an experienced Unreal Engine 5 gameplay programmer to build the core melee combat system for an original 3D action brawler, in the spirit of classic PS2-era brawlers like Urban Reign: close-range fights, strikes and grapples, reversals, and juggles.

This first milestone covers two playable characters with different fighting styles, using free placeholder assets on the UE5 Manny skeleton:
- Character A, all-rounder street fighter: punch strings, clinch and throws
- Character B, rushdown "tricking" fighter: fast kicks, flips, cancels into evades

Tech requirements
- UE 5.8, C++ (Blueprints only for asset wiring)
- UE5 Manny skeleton; placeholder animations from Paragon, Mixamo and Quaternius (retargeting included)
- Data-driven moves (DataAssets): startup, active and recovery frames, damage, hit zone, hit type, hitstun, blockstun, hitstop, cancel windows, combo routes
- Combat runs on a fixed 60 Hz frame counter, and all timing is in frames. The design must be able to move into a deterministic rollback simulation later.

Features to deliver
1. Light, Heavy and Grapple buttons with buffered combo strings and cancel windows
2. Guard with a guard meter and guard break
3. Strike and grapple reversals (timing-based counters)
4. Hitstop, knockback, launchers, juggles with scaling and a limit, knockdown and get-up
5. Crumple stun (once per combo) and OTG hits on a downed opponent (once per knockdown)
6. Body-part damage (head, body, legs) with gameplay effects
7. Grapples with paired animations and follow-ups
8. Lock-on facing, with movement relative to the target
9. Local 2-player play plus a simple AI opponent
10. Rounds and KO
11. Debug HUD showing frame data, combo count, juggle count, body-part damage and hitbox drawing
12. A test arena (free Megascans assets are fine)

Deliverables
- Source code and project files that compile cleanly (Development Editor, Win64)
- A playable test map
- A 30–60 second gameplay video showing every feature above
- A setup document explaining how to add a new move or character, plus a list of every third-party asset and its license

Requirements
- Strong UE5 C++ gameplay programming experience. Combat or fighting-game experience is required.
- Understands frame data, hitstop, cancels and juggle systems
- Understanding of rollback netcode is a big plus
- No generative AI. Code, animation and assets must be human-made or properly licensed free assets. This is a strict client requirement.
- NDA required before project details are shared

Timeline:2–3 days
Budget:5$/hr, paid by milestone:
- M1: core combat, strings, guard, hitstop
- M2: reversals, launch, juggle, knockdown, crumple, OTG, grapples
- M3: polish, AI, HUD, video and docs

When you apply, please answer:
1. Which combat or fighting games have you worked on, and what was your part? Include links or videos.
2. How would you structure frame data and combo routing in UE5?
3. How would you implement hitstop and juggle scaling?
4. Can you confirm no generative AI will be used?
5. What's your availability, and what's your estimate for each milestone?

• I will supply a list of everyday conversation prompts. Choose any 7 topics you both like.  
• For every chosen topic, record a free-flowing 20-minute chat. No reading or scripted lines—just natural back-and-forth conversation.  
• Record in a quiet indoor setting so there is no background noise, echo, or music.  
• Save each topic as a separate, high-quality WAV or 44.1 kHz MP3 file and label them clearly.

2. A short log sheet noting the participants’ first names, gender, and the topic title for each file.

**Website details and test accounts will be shared privately with shortlisted candidates.** You must be **18+ and comfortable reviewing an adult-industry jobs platform**.

**What we need tested**

**Candidate journey:**
- Browse jobs, search, filter, sort and navigate results.
- Open vacancies and assess whether pay, location, employer details and application instructions are clear.
- Register, complete email/OTP verification, log in and reset a password.
- Apply for jobs, including continuing to an employer’s website.
- Check that the selected job is preserved through registration and login.
- Save jobs, manage a profile and upload documents.

- Create or claim a business profile using supplied test businesses.
- Post and edit vacancies.
- Upload logos and documents.
- Test pricing and payment journeys using sandbox payments where available.

- Navigation, forms, validation messages and loading/error states.
- Broken links, buttons, missing content and confusing wording.

- Page URL and device/browser.
- Steps to reproduce.
- Expected versus actual behaviour.
- Severity and practical impact.
- Screenshots or short recordings.

Include a summary of the biggest usability problems and your five highest-priority improvements. Please include one retest after our developers address the reported issues.

Testing will primarily use staging and supplied test accounts. Any production testing must be agreed first. Do not contact real employers, submit genuine applications or make real payments. Keep website details, test data and recordings confidential.

**When applying, please include:**
- Relevant testing experience.
- Devices and browsers you can test, particularly iPhone/Safari and Android/Chrome.
- An example bug report.
- Your fixed-price quote, estimated hours and turnaround time.

We value thorough hands-on testing, clear communication and reports our developers can act on.

projects.title: Inventor RO Skid Modeling
projects.description:
I need a skilled Inventor user to finish a plumbing-piping-electrical Reverse Osmosis skid assembly so that I can present it to my client in a clear, photo-realistic way. I already have partial Inventor, Revit and 3D Plant files for reference; your job is to turn these into a single, fully detailed assembly that shows every major component, support, valve and fitting exactly where it belongs.


Scope  
• Start from the reference models I supply, verify dimensions against the photos and data inside the package, then complete any missing parts of the frame, pressure vessels, pumps, wiring trays, instruments and tie-in points.  
• Keep the model clean and parametrically organised—proper sub-assemblies, naming, and iProperties—because the file will later feed into Revit for coordination.  
• Add realistic materials and basic lighting so that rendered views are presentation-ready.

Deliverables  
• Inventor .iam and all related .ipt files, fully constrained and error-free.  
• Two or three high-resolution still renders (PNG or JPEG) that I can drop straight into a slide deck.  
• Optional: a Revit-compatible export (STEP or native .rvt) if you already work in that environment.

Acceptance criteria  
• No unresolved constraints, missing references or visibility errors when the model opens in Inventor 2022+.  
• All pipe routes, electrical conduits and supports match the connection points called out in the reference package.  
• File size and feature complexity kept reasonable so it will load smoothly in Revit.

If this first skid goes smoothly I have additional RO trains and pump skids coming up, so I’m looking for someone who can slot into my workflow long term. Let’s talk timing and any clarifications you need to get started.

projects.title: Classified Ads & Lead Generation Specialist – Pakistan
projects.description:
About Us

FAHAD Tutors Academy is a tutoring services company providing home and online tutoring across Pakistan and internationally.

We are looking for an experienced freelance specialist to build and manage a consistent, low-cost lead generation system through classified advertising platforms and relevant online marketplaces.

Target Cities: Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad (Karachi is the primary focus).

Responsibilities

1. Research and identify high-traffic classified websites and local marketplaces in Pakistan.
2. Create and manage advertisements for our tutoring services on suitable platforms, including OLX, Locanto, Facebook Marketplace and other permitted platforms.
3. Publish, renew and update advertisements according to a planned daily, weekly and monthly schedule.
4. Develop effective ad titles, descriptions and creatives to attract genuine parents looking for tutors.
5. Use separate tracking links for each platform and city.
6. Track and report genuine parent enquiries received from each platform.
7. Maintain a Google Sheet showing posting activity, live advertisement links and enquiry sources.
8. Research additional platforms and gradually expand the system to 30–50 relevant platforms, subject to performance.

Required Experience

- Hands-on experience with OLX and Pakistani classified websites.
- Classified advertising and online marketplace management.
- Facebook Marketplace listing management.
- Lead generation for service-based businesses.
- Basic advertisement copywriting and Canva.
- Google Sheets/Excel and lead tracking.
- Strong organisation, punctuality and communication skills.

Reporting & Deliverables

- Daily posting and renewal reports.
- Live links of published advertisements.
- Platform-wise and city-wise enquiry tracking.
- Weekly performance summary.
- Research and recommendations for new platforms.

Important Requirements

- This is a remote freelance position.
- The selected freelancer must personally manage the work.
- No fake, misleading or duplicate advertisements.
- All platform policies must be followed.
- Company accounts, advertising assets and lead data will remain the company's property.
- Strict confidentiality is required.
- We prefer someone interested in a long-term working relationship based on performance.

Initial Engagement

We will begin with a paid trial to evaluate work quality, consistency, platform selection and genuine parent enquiries. Successful performance may lead to an ongoing monthly engagement.

How to Apply

Please include:

1. A list of classified platforms you have personally worked with.
2. Your experience with OLX Pakistan and Facebook Marketplace.
3. Examples or screenshots of previous advertisements.
4. Any previous results generating leads for service-based businesses.
5. Your proposed strategy for generating parent enquiries in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad.
6. Your proposed charges for the initial trial and ongoing work.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical trial.

projects.title: Build AI Accounting SaaS Platform
projects.description:
Project Title: Full-Stack Developer Needed for AI-Powered Accounting Web Application
​Project Overview
We are looking for an experienced full-stack developer or team to build a web application with integrated AI capabilities. The application should be inspired by the core logic, speed, and minimalist user experience of platforms like simeron.ai, but built with our custom branding, specific use cases, and distinct features.
​Specifically, our application will function as an AI-powered accounting and invoicing platform for freelancers and small businesses. Users will be able to upload or scan invoices and receipts, while the AI automatically extracts the data and categorizes expenses/income. Users can also generate professional invoices and connect securely to external financial APIs (such as local tax authorities or bank feeds) to synchronize their accounting data. The goal is to eliminate manual data entry by using AI for document parsing and automated categorization.
​User Flow
The application must provide a seamless and fast experience from start to finish:
​User registration and authentication.
​Clean, distraction-free dashboard for uploading financial documents (receipts/invoices) or inputting accounting data.
​Rapid processing of the documents via an AI/OCR API to extract data and categorize it.
​Clear display of the extracted data with options to verify, edit, save, or export to accounting formats.
​Core Features Required
​Authentication System: Secure login using Email/Password and OAuth (Google).
​User Dashboard & Database: A secure database to save and display previous user sessions, uploaded documents, generated invoices, and categorized financial data.
​AI & OCR Integration: Seamless connection to an LLM or document parsing provider (e.g., OpenAI Vision, Anthropic, or AWS Textract) to process user uploads.
​External API Connections: Architecture capable of connecting with external tax authority APIs (like myDATA in Greece) and Open Banking APIs for data synchronization.
​Subscription Management (Optional but preferred): Integration with a payment gateway to manage premium tiers and usage limits.
​Proposed Tech Stack
You may propose your preferred framework, but we expect the use of modern, scalable technologies.
​Frontend (React.js, Vue.js, or Next.js): To build a fast, responsive, and modern user interface.
​Backend (Node.js, Python, Supabase, or Firebase): To manage users, secure API keys, and handle complex database operations.
​AI Engine (OpenAI API, Anthropic - Claude, Document AI): The core processing engine for data extraction and automated categorization.
​Payments (Stripe or PayPal): For handling subscriptions and automated billing.
​Project Milestones & Payment Structure
The project will be divided into the following deliverables:
​1. UI/UX Mockups: Delivery of interactive wireframes (e.g., in Figma) for approval before development begins.
​2. Minimum Viable Product (MVP): A functional build featuring successful user authentication, the core AI document parsing loop, and basic data categorization.
​3. Testing & Optimization: Debugging, handling edge cases, and ensuring API rate limits and accuracy of the AI extraction are optimized.
​4. Final Handover: Full deployment to our servers, alongside the transfer of all source code, documentation, and intellectual property rights.
​To Apply:
Please share examples of previous SaaS, AI, or accounting applications you have built, your proposed tech stack for this project, and an estimated timeline for the MVP.
